name: whichquant
description: Check every GGUF quant in a Hugging Face repo against your GPU and RAM before downloading it, by reading only the file headers, and get the llama.cpp flags for each one.
compatibility: Prints llama.cpp flags for each quant; with -q, also prints llama-server and KoboldCpp commands for the selected quants.
limitations: Weights are exact, but the compute buffer is an estimate and the KV cache follows llama.cpp's sizing rules.
GPU memory is detected only on NVIDIA and Apple Silicon; AMD and Intel users pass it with --gpu.
Checking a Hugging Face repo needs network access, and gated repos need HF_TOKEN; local GGUF files work offline.
It estimates fit and does not run or benchmark the model.

sources.note: Usage, supported hardware detection, accuracy notes and limits.
Test matrix covering Linux, macOS and Windows.
